character_ramp_why: the sheet is quantised through this 11-colour subset of the declared palette, so all four facings share one outfit by construction - four independent generations otherwise returned four different characters (measured 2026-10-16)
note: The idle and sleep columns are direct FLUX outputs; the walk and typing columns are deterministic pixel derivations of the same base (leg/arm region shifts + body bob), recorded per frame under `derivation`. The char_up / char_right / char_sleep bases are REFERENCE EDITS of char_down (klein's unified generate+edit mode, conditioning image = our own char_down.keyed.png), which is what holds one identity across the facings; no upstream or LimeZu pixels are involved anywhere.
